t2.title: Teamwork more important than individual talent
t2.prompt: You are participating in an online discussion forum. The topic is: "Is teamwork more important than individual talent?" Write your response, giving reasons and examples. Write 180–200 words.
t2.sample:
The debate between teamwork and individual talent is ongoing. I believe effective teamwork is generally more important than individual brilliance.

Firstly, complex challenges require diverse skills. No single person possesses all abilities needed for major projects. Teams combine different strengths – creativity, technical skills, leadership – achieving what individuals cannot.

Secondly, teamwork promotes innovation. When people collaborate, ideas build upon each other. Brainstorming sessions generate solutions that no individual would conceive alone. History's greatest achievements involved collaborative efforts.

However, individual talent remains crucial. Teams need talented members to function well. Moreover, some fields like art and music rely heavily on personal genius.

Nevertheless, even talented individuals need support systems. Athletes have coaches, musicians have producers, and scientists have research teams. Success is rarely achieved in isolation.

In conclusion, while individual talent is valuable, teamwork skills determine long-term success. Organizations should develop both, recognizing that collaboration multiplies individual capabilities.
t2.sampleA1:
Hi!
I think team is good.
I like team.
Bye
t2.sampleA2:
I think teamwork is good.
Because it is fun.
And we can do more things.
But some people are good alone.
So I like both.
t2.sampleB1:
In my opinion, teamwork is very important.
When people work together, they can do more than one person alone.
For example, in sports, a team needs everyone to play well.
If one person is very good but the team is not good, they will not win.
However, individual talent is also important.
A team needs some talented people to help the team win.
I think teamwork and individual talent are both important, but teamwork is maybe more important.
t2.sampleB2: Great question — this one always gets people talking, so I'll dive right in. For me, teamwork usually comes out on top. Don't get me wrong, a gifted individual can pull off incredible things, but most real challenges are simply too big for one person to shoulder alone. Take building an app: you need designers, coders and testers all pulling in the same direction. Even the sharpest programmer would struggle without that backup. What's more, working in a team brings fresh perspectives to the table, and that's often where the best ideas come from. When people bounce ideas off each other, they catch problems a single mind might miss. It's genuinely surprising how a quick group chat can spark a solution nobody saw coming on their own. That said, I wouldn't write off talent completely. A team of average players rarely wins anything, so you do need standout people to raise the bar. At the end of the day, though, it's blending those talents that really makes the difference. What do you all reckon? Has anyone had a project where teamwork made or broke the result? I'd love to hear your take! Sardor Usmonov
t2.uzSample:
Jamoaviy ish va individual iste'dod o'rtasidagi bahs davom etmoqda. Menimcha, samarali jamoaviy ish odatda individual yorqinlikdan muhimroqdir.

Birinchidan, murakkab muammolar turli xil ko'nikmalarni talab qiladi. Hech bir inson yirik loyihalar uchun zarur bo'lgan barcha qobiliyatlarga ega emas. Jamoalar turli xil kuchli tomonlarni - ijodkorlik, texnik ko'nikmalar, yetakchilikni birlashtirib, shaxslar qila olmaydigan narsalarga erishadilar.

Ikkinchidan, jamoaviy ish innovatsiyani rivojlantiradi. Odamlar hamkorlik qilganda, g'oyalar bir-birini to'ldiradi. Aqliy hujum sessiyalari hech bir shaxs yolg'iz o'zi o'ylab topa olmaydigan yechimlarni yaratadi. Tarixdagi eng buyuk yutuqlar hamkorlikdagi sa'y-harakatlar bilan bog'liq.

Biroq, individual iste'dod muhimligicha qoladi. Jamoalarga yaxshi ishlash uchun iste'dodli a'zolar kerak. Bundan tashqari, san'at va musiqa kabi ba'zi sohalar shaxsiy dahoga juda bog'liq.

Shunga qaramay, hatto iste'dodli shaxslarga ham qo'llab-quvvatlash tizimlari kerak. Sportchilarning murabbiylari, musiqachilarning prodyuserlari va olimlarning tadqiqot guruhlari bor. Muvaffaqiyatga kamdan-kam hollarda yolg'izlikda erishiladi.

Xulosa qilib aytganda, individual iste'dod qimmatli bo'lsa-da, jamoaviy ish ko'nikmalari uzoq muddatli muvaffaqiyatni belgilaydi. Tashkilotlar ikkalasini ham rivojlantirishi kerak, hamkorlik individual imkoniyatlarni ko'paytirishini tan olgan holda.
t2.uzSampleA1:
Salom!
Menimcha, jamoa yaxshi.
Menga jamoa yoqadi.
Xayr
t2.uzSampleA2:
Menimcha, jamoaviy ish yaxshi.
Chunki bu qiziqarli.
Va biz ko'proq narsalarni qila olamiz.
Lekin ba'zi odamlar yolg'iz yaxshi.
Shuning uchun menga ikkalasi ham yoqadi.
t2.uzSampleB1:
Mening fikrimcha, jamoaviy ish juda muhim.
Odamlar birgalikda ishlasa, ular bir kishi yolg'iz o'zi qilganidan ko'proq narsani qila oladi.
Misol uchun, sportda jamoaga hamma yaxshi o'ynashi kerak.
Agar bir kishi juda yaxshi bo'lsa, lekin jamoa yaxshi bo'lmasa, ular g'alaba qozonmaydi.
Biroq, individual iste'dod ham muhim.
Jamoaga g'alaba qozonishga yordam berish uchun ba'zi iste'dodli odamlar kerak.
Menimcha, jamoaviy ish ham, individual iste'dod ham muhim, lekin jamoaviy ish balki muhimroqdir.
t2.uzSampleB2:
Jamoaviy ish muhimroqmi yoki individual iste’dodmi degan savol murakkab, lekin men umumiy muvaffaqiyat uchun jamoaviy ish muhimroq degan fikrga moyilman.
Individual aql-zakovat sezilarli hissa qo'shishi mumkin bo'lsa-da, murakkab loyihalar va uzoq muddatli maqsadlar deyarli har doim ahil jamoaning birgalikdagi sa'y-harakatlarini talab qiladi.
Misol uchun, yangi dasturiy ta'minotni ishlab chiqish uchun dizaynerlar, dasturchilar, testerlar va loyiha menejerlari kerak bo'ladi, ularning barchasi umumiy maqsad sari birgalikda ishlaydi.
Hech bir shaxs bu ko'nikmalarning barchasiga ega bo'la olmaydi.

Bundan tashqari, jamoaviy ish a'zolar bir-biridan o'rganishi va individual ko'nikmalarini oshirishi mumkin bo'lgan qo'llab-quvvatlovchi muhitni yaratadi.
Aqliy hujum va hamkorlikda muammolarni hal qilish ko'pincha bitta odam o'ylab topishi mumkin bo'lganidan ko'ra innovatsion echimlarga olib keladi.
Albatta, individual iste'dod ham zarur; hech qanday ko'nikmaga ega bo'lmagan odamlardan iborat jamoa ko'p narsaga erisha olmaydi.
Ammo samarali hamkorlik qilish qobiliyati individual iste'dodlarni kuchaytiradi va ularni jamoa kontekstida yanada qimmatli qiladi.
Shuning uchun, individual iste'dod foydali bo'lsa-da, barqaror muvaffaqiyat uchun jamoaviy ish zarurdir.

t11.title: informal letter · to friend
t11.prompt: Write a letter to your friend, who is looking for a fun team activity for their birthday. Write about your feelings and what you think they should do.
t11.sample: Hey! I heard you're planning your birthday! I recently went to PuzzleMaster escape room and it was absolutely thrilling! Working together to solve puzzles was so much fun. Perfect for a team activity! You should definitely book it for your group! Take care!
t11.sampleA1:
Hi Farrux,
I go escape room. It is fun. You go?
Bye.
t11.sampleA2:
Hi Farrux,
I went to an escape room and it was good. The puzzles were hard but fun. You want to go for your birthday? It is a good idea because it is fun for a group. We can go together!
See you soon,
Nodirbek Xolmatov
t11.sampleB1:
Hi Farrux,
I wanted to tell you about something fun I did recently. I went to an escape room with some friends, and it was really good! We had to solve puzzles to get out of the room.
I think it would be a great idea for your birthday because it's a good team activity. Everyone can participate, and it's something different. You should check it out!
Best,
Nodirbek Xolmatov
t11.sampleB2: Hey Farrux! Happy early birthday! I hear you're on the lookout for a fun team activity, so let me throw in an idea. Last weekend my mates and I hit an escape room and honestly had a blast. We had to team up and crack the clues before time ran out — total adrenaline! Book one for your group; you won't regret it. Let me know! Cheers, Bekzod Aliyev

Salom!

Eshitishimcha, tug'ilgan kuningni rejalashtiryapsan! Men yaqinda PuzzleMaster kvest xonasiga bordim va bu juda hayajonli bo'ldi! Puzllarni yechish uchun birgalikda ishlash juda qiziqarli edi. Jamoaviy mashg'ulot uchun ajoyib! Guruhing uchun albatta bron qilishing kerak!

Men "escape room"ga bordim va u yaxshi edi. Topshiriqlar qiyin, lekin qiziqarli edi. Siz tug'ilgan kuningiz uchun bormoqchimisiz? Bu yaxshi fikr, chunki bu guruh uchun qiziqarli. Biz birga borishimiz mumkin!
Tez orada ko'rishguncha,

t11.uzSampleB1:
Salom Farrux,
Yaqinda qilgan qiziqarli bir ish haqida aytib bermoqchiman. Men bir nechta do'stlarim bilan "escape room"ga bordim va bu juda yaxshi bo'ldi! Biz xonadan chiqish uchun boshqotirmalarni yechishimiz kerak edi.
Menimcha, bu sizning tug'ilgan kuningiz uchun ajoyib g'oya bo'ladi, chunki bu yaxshi jamoaviy mashg'ulot. Hamma qatnashishi mumkin va bu boshqacha narsa. Buni tekshirib ko'ring!
Eng yaxshi tilaklar bilan,
Nodirbek Xolmatov
t11.uzSampleB2:
Aziz Farrux,

Umid qilamanki, bu xat sizga yaxshi yetib borgan. Yaqinda boshimdan o'tgan bir tajribani siz bilan baham ko'rmoqchiman, bu sizning tug'ilgan kuningizni nishonlash uchun juda mos keladi deb o'ylayman. Yaqinda men "escape room"ga bordim va bu juda ajoyib bo'ldi! Topshiriqlar qiyin, ammo qiziqarli edi va bu haqiqatan ham jamoaviy ish va muloqotni rag'batlantirdi.

Siz qiziqarli jamoaviy tadbir qidirayotganingizni hisobga olsak, men chin dildan "escape room" ajoyib tanlov bo'lishiga ishonaman. Bu noyob va unutilmas tajriba bo'lib, undan hamma zavqlanishi mumkin. Tug'ilgan kuningiz uchun seansga buyurtma berishni albatta o'ylab ko'rishingiz kerak – aminmanki, do'stlaringizga bu yoqadi!

Eng yaxshi tilaklar bilan,
Nodirbek Xolmatov

t12.title: formal letter · to recipient
t12.prompt: Write a letter to the escape room venue. Write about your feelings and what you think they should do.
t12.sample: Dear PuzzleMaster Team, Thank you for asking about my experience at your escape room venue. I was extremely impressed with the experience. The room design was incredibly immersive, and the puzzles were perfectly balanced – challenging but not frustrating. Our game master gave helpful hints without spoiling the fun. However, I have some suggestions. The waiting area was rather small for our group. Additionally, the sound effects in one room were quite loud and overwhelming. I would love to see more themed rooms like horror or sci-fi adventures. A difficulty rating system would help groups choose appropriate rooms. Also, offering photo packages at the end would create lasting memories. Overall, we had an unforgettable time. Yours sincerely, Nodirbek Xolmatov
t12.sampleA1:
Hi PuzzleMaster,


It was fun. The room was good. I liked the puzzles. Hard! The man helped us. More rooms please. Bye.
t12.sampleA2:
Dear PuzzleMaster,


Thank you for the escape room. It was good. The puzzles were hard, but fun. The game master helped us, and it was good. I think you need more rooms, because I want to come again. Maybe a room with monsters? That would be cool. Thank you.


From, Nodirbek Xolmatov
t12.sampleB1:
Dear PuzzleMaster Team,


Thank you for the email. I wanted to tell you about our visit to your escape room. It was a good experience. The room was interesting and the puzzles were quite challenging, but we enjoyed it. The game master was helpful and gave us clues when we needed them.


I think you could improve the waiting area, because it was a bit small. Also, maybe you could have different levels of difficulty for the rooms. For example, an easier room for beginners. I would also like to see a horror-themed room in the future.


Overall, we had a good time. Thanks again.


Sincerely,
Nodirbek Xolmatov
t12.sampleB2: Dear PuzzleMaster Team, Thank you for your kind message following our recent visit. I would like to share a few thoughts on our experience. On the whole, we had a fantastic time. The room themes were cleverly designed, and the puzzles struck a nice balance — tricky enough to keep us on our toes, yet never impossible. Our game master deserves special mention, as he stepped in with well-timed hints without giving anything away. That said, I do have a couple of suggestions. The waiting area felt rather cramped for a bigger group, so a little more space would go a long way. I would also love to see a horror-themed room added to your line-up. Thank you for taking my feedback on board. We will certainly be back. Yours sincerely, Dilnoza Karimova
t12.uzSample:
Hurmatli PuzzleMaster jamoasi,

Sizning escape room joyingizdagi tajribam haqida so'raganingiz uchun tashakkur.

Men olgan taassurotlar juda yuqori bo'ldi. Xonaning dizayni nihoyatda hayratlanarli, jumboqlar esa mukammal muvozanatda edi – qiyin, ammo umidsizlikka solmaydigan. O'yin ustamiz qiziqishni buzmasdan foydali maslahatlar berdi.

Biroq, mening ba'zi takliflarim bor. Kutish joyi bizning guruh uchun ancha kichik edi. Bundan tashqari, bir xonadagi ovoz effektlari juda baland va haddan tashqari edi.

Men dahshatli yoki ilmiy-fantastik sarguzashtlar kabi ko'proq tematik xonalarni ko'rishni xohlardim. Qiyinlik darajasini baholash tizimi guruhlarga mos xonalarni tanlashga yordam beradi. Shuningdek, yakunda foto to'plamlarni taklif qilish unutilmas xotiralar yaratadi.

Umuman olganda, biz unutilmas vaqt o'tkazdik.

Hurmat bilan, Nodirbek Xolmatov
t12.uzSampleA1:
Salom PuzzleMaster,


Qiziqarli bo'ldi. Xona yaxshi edi. Menga boshqotirmalar yoqdi. Qiyin! Bizga odam yordam berdi. Iltimos, ko'proq xonalar bo'lsin. Xayr.
t12.uzSampleA2:
Hurmatli PuzzleMaster,


Escape room uchun rahmat. U yaxshi edi. Topshiriqlar qiyin edi, lekin qiziqarli. O'yin ustasi bizga yordam berdi va bu yaxshi bo'ldi. Menimcha, sizga ko'proq xonalar kerak, chunki men yana kelmoqchiman. Ehtimol, yirtqich hayvonlar bilan xona bormi? Bu juda zo'r bo'lardi. Rahmat.


Sizdan, Nodirbek Xolmatov
t12.uzSampleB1:
Hurmatli PuzzleMaster jamoasi,


Xat uchun rahmat. Sizning escape roomingizga tashrifimiz haqida aytib bermoqchiman. Bu yaxshi tajriba bo'ldi. Xona qiziqarli edi va boshqotirmalar juda qiyin edi, lekin bizga yoqdi. O'yin ustasi yordam berdi va bizga kerak bo'lganda maslahatlar berdi.


Menimcha, kutish joyini yaxshilashingiz mumkin, chunki u biroz kichik edi. Shuningdek, xonalar uchun turli xil qiyinchilik darajalari bo'lishi mumkin. Masalan, yangi boshlanuvchilar uchun osonroq xona. Kelajakda dahshatli mavzudagi xonani ham ko'rishni xohlardim.


Umuman olganda, biz yaxshi vaqt o'tkazdik. Yana bir bor rahmat.


Hurmat bilan,
Nodirbek Xolmatov
t12.uzSampleB2:
Hurmatli PuzzleMaster jamoasi,


Ya недавно sizning escape room joyingizga tashrifimiz haqidagi so'rov xatingiz uchun rahmat. Men tajribamiz haqida fikr-mulohazalarimni bildirish uchun yozmoqdaman.


Umuman olganda, biz umumiy sifatdan mamnun bo'ldik. Xonaning tematikasi yaxshi bajarilgan, jumboqlar esa mos ravishda qiyin bo'lib, jamoaviy ish va noan'anaviy fikrlashni talab qildi. O'yin ustasi e'tiborli edi va yechimlarni muddatidan oldin aytmasdan foydali yo'l-yo'riqlar berdi.


Biroq, yaxshilanishi mumkin bo'lgan bir nechta sohalar mavjud. Birinchidan, xonamizdagi fon musiqasi ba'zan chalg'itardi va immersiv tajribaga putur yetkazdi. Ikkinchidan, jumboqlar qiyin bo'lsa-da, ulardan biri yoki ikkitasi biroz mantiqsiz tuyuldi va deduksiya o'rniga ishonch bilan sakrashni talab qildi.


Kelajakdagi mavzular nuqtai nazaridan, tarixiy sirlar yoki ilmiy fantastika hikoyasi atrofida qurilgan xona ayniqsa jozibali bo'lar edi. Shuningdek, mijozlarga o'z mahorat darajasiga mos keladigan xonalarni tanlash imkonini berish uchun batafsilroq qiyinchilik reytingi tizimini joriy etish foydali bo'lishi mumkin. Ehtimol, eng tez yakunlash vaqtlari uchun yetakchilar jadvalini qo'shish ham takroriy tashriflarni rag'batlantirishi mumkin.


Umuman olganda, biz tashrifimizdan zavqlandik va kelajakda qaytib kelishni o'ylab ko'ramiz. Ushbu takliflarga e'tiboringiz uchun rahmat.


Hurmat bilan,
Nodirbek Xolmatov
